basis: User explicitly requests execution of G0-Z0 plan after first20 quality-stop receipt. This authorizes the one semantic revision already allowed by the frozen research contract; it does not create unavailable data or a bulk endpoint.

resolved_now.question: 再修一次还是扩量？
resolved_now.decision: Use the single allowed v1.1 semantic revision, preserve v1 and failed annotations. Replace failed Terra extraction with Sol/medium as permitted by the task table. Two fresh Sol/medium readings of a fixed unused20 (10 old A +10 old B) within existing config80 provide bounded AI cross-checks. Same-model agreement is not accuracy.

resolved_now.question: 资格替代的经验年限是否保留？
resolved_now.decision: Yes. Retain explicit work-year branches conditional on education. Add qualification_scope and exact condition evidence; keep them separate from unconditional tenure. A degree itself does not create years of employment.

resolved_now.question: 软件组能否称计算机革命的因果反事实？
resolved_now.decision: No. Existing H1-H3 rulings stand. Common task/role comparison and descriptive CPS occupational composition remain available; original historical causal comparison remains a research target pending corresponding inputs.

resolved_now.question: 无API能否继续正式提取和分析？
resolved_now.decision: Prepare the resumable/cache/failure/evidence interface; do not pretend40300 LLM production is executable. Execute available aggregate LinkUp analyses now with candidate/coverage labels. No API purchase, no new credential question.

resolved_now.question: Revelio没有实物如何处理？
resolved_now.decision: R0 reference interface only. Actual R0, R1-R3 and J1 cross-source empirical work deferred until user provides acquired data. Do not simulate empirical results.

resolved_now.question: 部署现有AI算普通使用还是实施？
resolved_now.decision: 为他人安装、配置、部署或集成系统/工作流归implement_integrate；自己借现成AI完成业务任务归use_operate；缺少目的的孤立维护保持role_unspecified。部署维护都不单独证明develop_train。此处纠正同一次v1.1代码交付中的过宽句子，两名盲读者同步收到同一规则，未参考其标签结果。

scope: Execution attachment, not a rewrite of the research plan.

L5_root_interpretation_once.engineering: Large connected coverage supports proceeding with descriptive measurement; it does not establish population representativeness or correct historical text dates.
L5_root_interpretation_once.stable_general_signal: The old general-experience contrast is numerically similar across shown specifications, but occupational experience was not separately measured. Stability of an old proxy does not establish a robust general-tenure finding.
L5_root_interpretation_once.tool_signal: The tool contrast changes with measurement rules and common support, and software-group selection uses related vocabulary. Do not present its negative sign as AI equalization or reduced skill requirements.
L5_root_interpretation_once.advance: Publish coverage/time-risk and old-rule sensitivity artifacts now. Interpret revised experience combinations only with accepted object, qualification-scope and role evidence; do not add regressions to compensate for unvalidated measurement.
